def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + 0.25 * p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + sqrt(p))

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d - mean_d) / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p) ** 0.5

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p) ** 2

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + progress / 10)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d - 0.25 * mean_d) / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + stagnation / 10)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return 2 * (d / (1 + p))

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p) + 0.1 * abs(d - mean_d)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d - mean_d * clip(progress / 4, 0, 1)) / (1 + p)
